title: Programmatic Advertising Services for Small Businesses | BidWaves

facts.fact: BidWaves's 2026 Small Business Ad Efficiency Report includes a 10-step playbook covering geo-targeting, ad scheduling, negative keywords, and AI automation.
facts.quote: It provides a 10-step playbook featuring geo-targeting, ad scheduling, negative keywords, and AI automation

facts.fact: BidWaves states that it optimizes bids, audiences, placements, and creative on a monthly cycle for programmatic clients.
facts.quote: We optimize bids, audiences, placements, and creative each month, then report results and next steps in plain language.

facts.fact: BidWaves states that it reviews results and prioritizes next actions each month as part of its reporting and refinement step.
facts.quote: We review what’s driving results, refine strategy, and prioritize next actions each month.
